cases.title: Design a narrowly scoped MCP server

input.request: Design a TypeScript MCP server for a read-only inventory API. Define the tool surface, validated schemas, transport, output shape, pagination, and error behavior.

success_criteria: Workflow tools and generic endpoint coverage are explicitly balanced
Schemas bound types, size, pagination, and invalid inputs
Transport and SDK versions are recorded as assumptions or verified facts
Errors reveal no secrets or stack traces

properties: Workflow tools and generic endpoint coverage are explicitly balanced

automated_checks: skill-specific output properties are checked by a task grader when available

cases.title: Test MCP authorization and failures

input.request: Build a test plan for an MCP tool that retrieves customer orders from a staging system, including cross-user access, timeouts, malformed upstream responses, retries, and redaction.

success_criteria: Authorization is enforced server-side for each object access
Denied and cross-boundary requests have explicit assertions
Timeout, retry, pagination, malformed-data, and idempotency behavior are covered where applicable
Logs and artifacts redact credentials and personal data

cases.title: Verify real client-path compatibility

input.request: Review an MCP server that starts successfully but has not been tested through the intended client. Define the verification needed before a release recommendation.

success_criteria: Server startup is not treated as client compatibility proof
At least one integration case uses the planned client/SDK surface
Tool discovery, invocation, invalid arguments, and protocol errors are tested
Release decision distinguishes tested behavior from deployment assumptions
